name: thomasdubdub/eurocontrol-data-archive
what_it_holds: Python framework (archive.py + 4 Jupyter notebooks) to load and visualize the EUROCONTROL R&D Data Archive (flight trajectories, e.g. 'short-haul flights over German upper airspace') as pandas/GeoPandas dataframes. No committed datasets -- wraps the external EUROCONTROL R&D archive (eurocontrol.int/dashboard/rnd-data-archive), which itself requires registration to access underlying flight data.
why_useful: Only third-party (non-EUROCONTROL-org) tool found with real stars (9) for EUROCONTROL data; marginal for ABNB nights/ADR forecasting since it is trajectory/airspace-level, not airport passenger counts, and requires external archive access.
themes: European and global aviation stats: Eurocontrol, EASA, ACI airport passenger stats, IATA public figures, airport monthly traffic scrapers (Heathrow, Schiphol, ADP, Fraport, AENA)
why_all: Only third-party (non-EUROCONTROL-org) tool found with real stars (9) for EUROCONTROL data; marginal for ABNB nights/ADR forecasting since it is trajectory/airspace-level, not airport passenger counts, and requires external archive access.

name: Heathrow-noise (BBC Data Unit)
what_it_holds: BBC Data Unit journalism repo scraping Heathrow's public noise-complaint portal, logging aircraft landing/noise complaint events roughly every five minutes; a byproduct data trail of landing frequency rather than an official passenger count.
why_useful: Landing-frequency-as-noise-complaint-count could be a rough proxy for Heathrow flight cadence, but it's noise-complaint volume (confounded by public complaint behavior, not raw traffic) and a one-off journalism scrape, not an ongoing dataset - marginal use only if nothing else is available for high-frequency Heathrow activity.
last_activity: unspecified, appears to be a completed one-off data-journalism project
themes: European and global aviation stats: Eurocontrol, EASA, ACI airport passenger stats, IATA public figures, airport monthly traffic scrapers (Heathrow, Schiphol, ADP, Fraport, AENA)
why_all: Landing-frequency-as-noise-complaint-count could be a rough proxy for Heathrow flight cadence, but it's noise-complaint volume (confounded by public complaint behavior, not raw traffic) and a one-off journalism scrape, not an ongoing dataset - marginal use only if nothing else is available for high-frequency Heathrow activity.

name: lhrnet
what_it_holds: Neural-network project predicting Heathrow runway direction/usage from OpenSky-derived flight data; a modeling exercise built on live OpenSky pulls, no committed historical passenger or flight-count dataset of its own.
why_useful: Not a data source per se; runway-usage prediction is orthogonal to passenger volume. Low relevance beyond illustrating another OpenSky-based Heathrow project.
time_coverage: unspecified (live OpenSky data at time of project)
themes: European and global aviation stats: Eurocontrol, EASA, ACI airport passenger stats, IATA public figures, airport monthly traffic scrapers (Heathrow, Schiphol, ADP, Fraport, AENA)
why_all: Not a data source per se; runway-usage prediction is orthogonal to passenger volume. Low relevance beyond illustrating another OpenSky-based Heathrow project.
